_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: List a company's funding rounds

description: List a US company's private funding rounds from its SEC Form D filings: for the newest five, the offering size, the amount sold, the first sale date, the number of investors and the security type, with the filing link; older filings are listed by date. Send name (such as Stripe; the best EDGAR match is used and other_matches lists other companies it matched; a filer with no Form D is not found), domain (such as stripe.com, through the SEC number on its Wikidata item) or cik. Many rounds are never filed on Form D, and companies outside the US rarely file. No investor or officer is named. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

cik.description: The SEC Central Index Key, such as 1691342.

domain.description: The company's domain, such as stripe.com.

name.description: The company's name, such as Stripe.

name: data_company_funding
title: List a company's funding rounds
